allocation_accounting: Sum all future stage invocation wall durations including initialization, matrix evaluations, simulations, export and inspection. Harness/prerequisite work also needs an explicit reconciled allocation before numerical execution. No uncounted prewarming, pilots or failed starts. Unused time not silently transferred.
worker_policy: fresh isolated sequential native SINGLE workers; no overlapping benchmark, tests, rendering or analysis
resource_observation_limit: RSS/disk sampled ceiling; kernel hard limit only if supported/validated. A sampled watcher cannot certify no between-sample overshoot; hard RSS enforcement on macOS must be qualified before claiming a hard bound.

resource_actions.before_each_worker: Check available stage/aggregate time, output bytes, >=1 GiB free, no MEASURED_ACTIVE/D3_ACTIVE owner conflict; record guard ownership, never remove another guard
resource_actions.during: At 0.1 s poll elapsed monotonic wall, worker RSS, filesystem free space and output growth; flush bounded structured observations; ensure process group reaped on timeout
resource_actions.at_ceiling: Stop launching immediately; ask worker to flush/checkpoint, <=1 s grace then terminate worker process group; preserve partial writes and explicit truncation; supervision/grace counted inside allocation
resource_actions.wall_reserve: Reserve final 5 s of each stage for termination and partial manifest. Do not launch a trial if <5 s remains. Per CT1N/CT1R worker timeout <=30 s and <=remaining minus reserve; CT1L timeout <=remaining minus reserve.
resource_actions.output_ceiling: All new data, logs, temporary files and exports share 1 GiB; at 95% stop launching, flush within remaining 5%; do not delete earlier evidence
resource_actions.RSS_ceiling: At >=1 GiB observed worker RSS stop worker; log max RSS and enforcement limitations
resource_actions.disk_floor: Below 1 GiB free stop worker; initial 2 GiB is verified immediately before stage, not inferred from this plan

supported native controls configured before numerical imports in fresh subprocess

trial IDs/order, source rows/packet IDs, branch/worktree identity and checkpoint/harness scope

Review perturbation magnitudes, proposed synthetic bounds, baseline limitations, timing confounding and unsupported estimation exclusion

scientific_stop_conditions: source/config/environment mismatch or ambiguous packet authority
invalid chronology, future information leakage, accidental model/parameter sharing
invalid initial state, any invalid RK4 intermediate/final state, axle load or square-root reserve violation
physical center corridor crossing or predicted material slack >1e-6 m; preserve immediate offending observation
unexpected fallback, gain/preparation/solver failure; stop affected branch pending review
packet expiry ModeA: expected censored observation, no extrapolation
same-time clip/domain/knot branch ambiguity: label unavailable, do not manufacture smoothness
resource cap or unsafe guard ownership: retain partial/censored evidence; no rerun to replace outcome

separate_authorization_requests.request: After Secondary review, authorize only the twelve source-bound local-matrix evaluations, <=960 gain-grid samples and specified cross-checks, <=300 s; no nonlinear trials or optimization solves. First resolve derivative qualification and report lost coverage.

Separately authorize reviewed harness/prerequisites and then up to 80 specified one-channel trials, <=800 s, only after checkpoint, perturbation, timing and cap reconciliation. No inferred permission from CT1L approval.

Separately authorize reviewed harness/prerequisites and then up to 32 plant-only synthetic mismatch trials, <=400 s. Estimation/noise, interactions, baselines and retuning excluded pending new reviewed plan/cap.

reruns: No unfavorable replacement; failures, instability, infeasibility and censoring retained. A diagnostic repetition needs separately documented authorization and linked original result.
